patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: League night, three games back to back, and now my elbow is screaming at me. I average 180 and I am not stopping. Just tell me what to take.
presentation.triageNote: 57-year-old male with two weeks of lateral elbow pain worse on gripping, with point tenderness over the lateral epicondyle and an intact neurovascular examination.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this chronic overuse elbow pain has a diagnostic examination and requires no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has two weeks of lateral elbow pain provoked by gripping with focal epicondylar tenderness and intact distal function.
clinical.acuityReason: The atraumatic overuse pattern and normal neurovascular examination do not support imaging or urgent testing.
keyFindings: Two weeks of lateral elbow pain
teachingPoints: Activity modification and progressive rehabilitation are more useful than immobilization.
Trauma, joint swelling, fever, weakness, or neurologic symptoms would broaden evaluation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Brace advice, oral pain treatment, and outpatient rehabilitation would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 57-year-old man in a bowling league shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with his right arm held out, left hand cupping the outer elbow
signs: a hand cupping the outer elbow
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: entirely well, annoyed about his elbow
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 57-year-old man in an embroidered bowling league shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair, with an OPEN bowling bag on the floor at his feet and a swirled marbled bowling ball clearly visible sitting inside it. Pose: sitting with his right arm held out in front of him, his left hand cupping the outer side of the right elbow. Expression: gruff and mildly indignant. Clearly visible: a hand cupping the outer elbow; a bowling league shirt; an open bowling bag at his feet with a swirled bowling ball sitting inside it. Overall: entirely well, annoyed about his elbow. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
